estimates.assumptions: Medium red pepper (about 150g whole) diced; all edible.
Small bunch coriander ≈25g total (stalks + leaves); typical supermarket bunch weight used for the whole herb.
1 small red chilli ≈15g whole; fully edible after chopping.
Density of dry white wine ≈1g/ml, so 400ml = 400g.
Typical pinch of saffron threads is 0.1-0.3g; used 0.2g as modest average for a recipe pinch.
1 dried bay leaf weighs ≈0.5g; fully used in recipe.
8 tiger prawns (large, ~25g each raw, peeled weight); modest edible portion estimate for 8 prawns.
1 standard baguette ≈250g total edible weight when sliced for serving; typical baguette density/calories used since known value was null.
